messages:
emma_cs: FYI Acadia's security team flagged embedding retention in our vendor form. They want a per-tenant opt-out for storing embeddings that contain direct identifiers. They called it a hard stop for procurement.

raj_se: can you paste their exact language?

emma_cs: theirs: 
```
We require a per-tenant opt-out to prevent persistent storage of embeddings derived from any text containing direct identifiers (SSN, bank acct, driver license). Without this control, procurement will not approve.
```

lina_legal: sounds like we can solve contractually + technically. Legal can draft a DPA addendum referencing a technical control and a short attestation for SOC2 evidence. We'll need the data flow diagram showing where embeddings are stored.

ben_eng: technical approaches: (A) scrub PII on ingest, (B) add an API opt-out flag so embeddings are never persisted for a tenant, (C) tenant-scoped ephemeral storage with key rotation.

raj_se: what's the fastest to provide as a stop-gap the customer can point to?

ben_eng: fastest = opt-out flag + audit trail. We can surface an API parameter like:
```json
{"retain_embeddings": false, "retain_embeddings_reason": "pii_exclusion"}
```
Server-side we simply skip writing the vector to persistent storage and return ephemeral embeddings. We'll also emit an audit log row per request (tenant id, request id, flag). Rough ETA: 1 sprint if we prioritize + feature-flag rollout.

emma_cs: Acadia needs something they can reference within 10 business days or they'll pause onboarding.

lina_legal: Legal will draft the addendum and a one-page SOC2-style attestation if engineering confirms the behavior and timeline.

ben_eng: engineering confirms: opt-out + audit logging is feasible in ~10 biz days if prioritized. Longer-term: implement per-tenant retention policies with KMS-separated stores.

emma_cs: great. I'll tell Acadia we have a temporary technical control and a legal addendum draft in two weeks. Who owns comms and delivery? @raj_se can you be lead for eng? Lina for legal?

raj_se: I'll own the eng scope. I'll create a short PRD with acceptance criteria today and list blockers.

lina_legal: I'll start drafting the DPA addendum and the attestation template.

onboard-bot: ticket update: Onboarding #ONB-2247 moved to "blocked: embedding retention"; eskew ETA 10 business days.

emma_cs: thanks team. I'll push on the customer's side for a temporary procurement note. Please add any test cases or docs snippets to the PRD. :thumbsup:

raj_se: TODOs added to PRD: integration tests, audit log schema, feature-flag rollout plan, docs snippet, API surface decision (enterprise-only?).

ben_eng: note: need product signoff on exposing the `retain_embeddings` param publicly or restrict to enterprise tenants behind auth.

emma_cs: I'll loop in product if needed. Thanks everyone :eyes:
